notes.title: Update v1.0.7 IS OUT
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 1.0.7 fixes Steam Deck bugs & improves drastically the performance on Steam Decks and low end PCs. [/b][/h1]

[b]On Steam Deck LCD you'll get 30-50fps with the following settings:

Screen Resolution: 1280x800
Texture Quality: High
Post Processing: Medium
Shadow Quality: Low
Foliage: Medium
View Distance: High
Shading: Medium
Effects: Medium
Anti-Alising: Ultra[/b]



Changes of Previous updates:

-less duration till stamina starts recharging
-Stamina recharges ~40% faster while walking
-Stamina recharges ~25% faster while crouching
-Aliens hearing radius 40% less (they can't find you that easy anymore while hiding in cabinets)
-Hand crank flashlight Lights up 30% faster.
-English misspelling fix
-Ladder bug fix
-baryard level fix, aliens couldn't catch you on a bin
-Key rebinding Option
-Voice Volume Option
-Music Volume Option
-Bigger Triggers in Cornfield level
-50% Higher crouch speed
-Stamina Recharges 2x Faster
-Flashlight requires 50% less charging
-Higher Volume at Henry's voices
-bigger rectangle at interaction
-more direction by objective markers through lamps & lights
-Spanish translation fix
-French translation fix
-Italian translation fix
-Japanese translation fix
-Polish translation fix
-Portuguese translation fix
-Simplified Chinese translation fix


Thanks so much for your feedback!

notes.title: Greyhill Incident is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone, 

We are happy to announce that Greyhill Incident is Finally out and want to thank you so much for your support over the last months during development! 
[previewyoutube=OlVesw01h0w;full][/previewyoutube]
Greyhill Incident is our homage to the classic Alien Invasion Topic, and we hope that it's enjoyable for the Alien Fans out there.

Thanks again and grab your Tin foil hats! It's time to jump into Greyhill! [/b]

notes.title: Greyhill Incident is releasing June 9th 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone, 

We are happy to announce that Greyhill Incident releases on June 9th 2023 on Steam, PS5 & XBOX X|S! 
[previewyoutube=X816WRwlEjw;full][/previewyoutube]

As you may already know, it's inspired by 'true incidents', books, tv shows & films from "Fire in the Sky" over to "The X-Files", "Communion" and other works of the past.

Greyhill Incident is our homage to the classic grey Alien & UFO topic and we're working hard to make it the best experience, as we can.


Greyhill became way bigger than originally planned and we can't wait for you to play it! 



[/b]

notes.title: Greyhill Incident - New Trailer & Console Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,

Today we released a new Trailer and are happy to announce that we managed to bring Greyhill Incident to Consoles! 
It comes to Playstation 4 & Playstation 5.[/b]

[previewyoutube=fq-bnh9E5Ho;full][/previewyoutube]

As you may already know, it's inspired by 'true incidents', books, tv shows & films from "Fire in the Sky" over to "The X-Files", "Communion" and other works of the past. 

Greyhill Incident is our homage to the classic grey Alien & UFO topic and we're working hard to make it the best experience, as we can. 

You can wishlist it on Steam if you haven't already, but if you would rather like to play on Playstation, you can wishlist it in the Playstation Store!
